title: volvulus roseus
intro: Volvulus roseus, commonly known as Indian snake root, is a plant species belonging to the Asperugo genus. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Volvulus roseus include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to alleviate conditions such as fever, skin infections, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Volvulus roseus include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic effects.
